title: A legend taller than the viewport is cut off, hiding Max/Min
body:
### Observed failure
A results legend taller than the viewport is cut off at the bottom, and the navigation bar covers its last bands and the clickable Max/Min lines.

### Reproduction
1. Open the Cantilever sample, solve it, show von Mises.
2. Set the legend to 24 bands with a clamped range.
3. Resize the window to 960 × 600 (`ui.resize`).

The legend is 507 pt tall in a 406 pt viewport. Since #608 it also starts 35 pt lower (below the selection bar), so 35 pt more is hidden.

### Expected behaviour
The whole legend stays readable at any window size, including Max/Min. For example, fewer swatch labels when space is short, two columns, or scrolling.

Found while reviewing #608.
